title: Extract fieldwork::cards module with DB queries
description:
Now that fieldwork owns the schema, extract link preview cards WITH persistence into fieldwork.

Source: GJ cards.rs (687 lines, most complete).

Module split:
1. Pure logic (no DB):
   - fetch_card(client: &reqwest::Client, url: &url::Url) -> Result<CardData> — HTTP fetch with SSRF validation, content-length check, timeout
   - parse_opengraph(html: &str) -> CardData — regex-based OG tag extraction (property + name attrs), HTML entity decoding, title/description truncation
   - detect_card_type(card: &CardData) -> &str — video/photo/link classification
   - CardData struct (url, title, description, image_url, card_type, author, provider)

2. Persistence (uses fieldwork::db::Pool):
   - get_cached_card(pool, url: &str) -> Result<Option<CardRow>> — check link_cards cache (< 24h)
   - is_recent_failure(pool, url: &str) -> Result<bool> — check failed flag (< 1h)
   - upsert_card(pool, card: &CardRow) -> Result<()> — ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (Postgres) / INSERT OR REPLACE (SQLite)
   - link_card_to_post(pool, post_id: i64, card_url: &str) -> Result<()> — post_cards junction
   - cards_for_posts(pool, post_ids: &[i64]) -> Result<HashMap<i64, CardRow>> — batch load
   - CardRow struct matching canonical link_cards + post_cards tables

3. Orchestration:
   - fetch_and_cache_card(pool, client, url, post_id) -> Result<Option<CardRow>> — check cache, fetch if stale, upsert, link to post

Deps: reqwest, ssrf-guard, regex, serde_json, sqlx via db features.

Note: Postgres uses ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE, SQLite uses INSERT OR REPLACE. Both are in fieldwork::db::Pool dispatch.
